# Quick Work Comp

> Quick Work Comp (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides same-day workers' compensation quotes and certificates for contractors in all 50 states. Coverage options: same-day WC quotes & certificates, pay-as-you-go workers' comp, ghost policy / minimum WC for sole proprietors, contractor workers' comp for all trades, PEO alternative coverage, same-day certificate of insurance (COI), standard annual WC policies, and WC premium audit defense. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, same-day certificate issuance. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com, 12220 E Riggs Road, Suite #104, Chandler, AZ 85249.

## Services (8 solutions)

- [Same-Day WC Quotes & Certificates](/services/same-day-quotes): Quote, bind, and certificate issued the same day — often within 15 minutes.
- [Pay-As-You-Go Workers' Comp](/services/pay-as-you-go): Premium tied to actual payroll — no big down payment, no audit surprises.
- [Ghost Policy / Minimum WC](/services/ghost-policy): Minimum-premium WC for exempt owner-operators who need a COI for GC requirements.
- [Contractor Workers' Comp](/services/contractor-wc): Standard WC for all trades — roofing, framing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and more.
- [PEO Alternative Coverage](/services/peo-alternative): Own your own WC policy instead of using a PEO — more control, no co-employment.
- [Same-Day COI](/services/certificate-of-insurance): ACORD 25 certificate issued same day coverage is bound, including waivers of subrogation.
- [Standard Annual WC Policy](/services/annual-wc-policy): Traditional annual WC from A-rated carriers — all trades, all experience levels.
- [WC Premium Audit Defense](/services/wc-audit-defense): Dispute misclassifications and reduce audit bills for contractors who've been overbilled.

## Key contractor markets

- [Texas Contractors](/locations/texas): Largest contractor WC market — non-subscriber option, same-day quotes.
- [Florida Contractors](/locations/florida): Construction boom — ghost policies and same-day COIs in high demand.
- [California Contractors](/locations/california): DIR enforcement — compliant WC and fast certificates for licensed contractors.
- [Arizona Contractors](/locations/arizona): Fast-growing market — same-day binding and certificate issuance.
- [Georgia Contractors](/locations/georgia): Southeast construction surge — same-day COIs for all trades.
- [North Carolina Contractors](/locations/north-carolina): Fast-growing construction market — sub compliance and same-day certificates.
- [Ohio Contractors](/locations/ohio): State fund vs private market — pay-as-you-go for small contractors.
- [Illinois Contractors](/locations/illinois): Large union and open shop market — same-day WC certificates.
